function randomdir(y)
	local ranx = (math.random()-.5)*2
	local rany = (math.random()-.5)*2
	local ranz = (math.random()-.5)*2
	if ranx^2+rany^2+ranz^2 < 1 and ranx^2+rany^2+ranz^2 > 0 then
		return Vector3.new(ranx,rany,ranz).unit
	else
		return randomdir()
	end
end

function randomdiry()
	local ranx = (math.random()-.5)*2
	local rany = (math.random()+1)/2
	local ranz = (math.random()-.5)*2
	return Vector3.new(ranx,rany,ranz).unit
end

function createParticle(img,dir,grv,size,orig,tim,res)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui",orig)
	gui.Size = size
	gui.Name = "gui"
	--gui.StudsOffset = pos
	gui.Adornee = orig
	local rotation = math.random()*360
	for n, imgid in pairs(img) do
		local new = Instance.new("ImageLabel",gui)
		new.BorderSizePixel = 0
		new.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		new.Image = imgid
		new.Name = ""..n
		new.Size = UDim2.new((n-1)*0.015+1,0,(n-1)*0.015+1,0)
		new.Position = UDim2.new(-((n-1)*0.015)/2,0,-((n-1)*0.015)/2,0)
		new.ZIndex = n
		new.Rotation = rotation
	end
	--[[local gravity = Instance.new("Vector3Value",gui)
	local velocity = Instance.new("Vector3Value",gui)
	gravity.Name = "grav"
	velocity.Name = "velo"
	gravity.Value = grv
	velocity.Value = dir
	gui.Name = ""..math.random(-45,45)
	table.insert(particles,gui)]]
	table.insert(particles,{gui,math.random(-45,45),grv,dir,tim,res})
end


delay(0,function()
	while true do
	local t = wait()
	--print(#particles)
	for n, particle in pairs(particles) do
		local p = particle[1]:GetChildren() 
			if #p == 0 then
				particle[1].Parent:Destroy()
				particles[n] = nil
			else
				local cur = particle[1][""..#p]
				cur.ImageTransparency = cur.ImageTransparency + t/particle[5]
				particle[1].Parent.CFrame = CFrame.new(particle[1].Parent.Position+particle[4]*t)
				particle[4] = (particle[4]+particle[3]*t)*particle[6]^t
				for i = 1, #p do
					particle[1][""..i].Rotation = particle[1][""..i].Rotation + particle[2]*t
				end
				if cur.ImageTransparency >= 1 then
					cur:Destroy()
				end
				if cur.Name == "1" then
					particle[1].Size = UDim2.new(particle[1].Size.X.Scale*0.5^t,0,particle[1].Size.Y.Scale*0.5^t,0)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
function createexplosion(size,position)
	local distance = player:DistanceFromCharacter(position)
	local detail = math.max(0,math.min(1,(220-distance)/220+0.1))
	local imgsize = size^0.5*2.2*(1.8-detail*0.8)
	print(detail)
	
	for i = 1, math.ceil((size^(1+0.35*detail)*3)+5) do
		local origin = Instance.new("Part")
		origin.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
		origin.Anchored = true
		origin.Transparency = 1
		origin.CanCollide = false
		origin.Position = position
		origin.Parent = script
		local dir = randomdir() * size * 1.6 * (0.8+math.random()*0.4)--(size*15)^0.5
		--dir = Vector3.new(dir.X^0.5,dir.Y^0.5,dir.Z^0.5)
		createParticle(img[math.random(1,#img)],dir,Vector3.new(0,0,0),UDim2.new((0.8+math.random()*0.4)*imgsize,0,(0.8+math.random()*0.4)*imgsize,0),origin,size^.3,0.17)
	end
	
	local smoken = math.ceil(size^(1+0.35*detail) + 4)
	for i = 1, smoken do
		local origin = Instance.new("Part")
		origin.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
		origin.Anchored = true
		origin.Transparency = 1
		origin.CanCollide = false
		origin.Position = position
		origin.Parent = script
		--print(Vector3.new(math.sin(i/smoken)*2*math.pi,0,math.cos(i/smoken)*2*math.pi))
		local dir = Vector3.new(math.sin(i/smoken*2*math.pi),0,math.cos(i/smoken*2*math.pi)) * size * 2.75 * (0.8+math.random()*0.4)
		--dir = Vector3.new(dir.X^0.5,dir.Y^0.5,dir.Z^0.5)
		createParticle(smoke[math.random(1,#smoke)],dir,Vector3.new(0,0,0),UDim2.new((0.8+math.random()*0.4)*imgsize,0,(0.8+math.random()*0.4)*imgsize,0),origin,size^.3,0.17)
	end
	
	for i = 1, math.random(3,4) do
		local origin = Instance.new("Part")
		origin.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
		origin.Anchored = true
		origin.Transparency = 1
		origin.CanCollide = false
		origin.Position = position
		origin.Parent = script
		local dir = randomdiry() * size * 4 * (0.8+math.random()*0.4)
		createParticle(fire[math.random(1,#fire)],dir,Vector3.new(1,-1,1)*dir*0.2,UDim2.new((0.8+math.random()*0.4)*size^0.5*2,0,(0.8+math.random()*0.4)*size^0.5*2,0),origin,size^.3*2,.3)
		table.insert(trails,origin)
	end
end

workspace.ChildAdded:connect(function(c)
	if c:IsA("Explosion") then
		createexplosion(c.BlastRadius,c.Position)
		local origin = Instance.new("Part")
		origin.Size = Vector3.new()
		origin.Anchored = true
		origin.Transparency = 1
		origin.CanCollide = false
		origin.Position = c.Position
		origin.Parent = script
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight",origin)
		light.Range = c.BlastRadius*3
		light.Color = Color3.new(255/255,200/255,100/255)
		light.Brightness = 4
		local t = c.BlastRadius^.3
		while t > 0 do
			t = t - wait()
			light.Range = t/(c.BlastRadius^.3)*c.BlastRadius*3
		end
		origin:Destroy()
	end
end)
